summary: Horizon Kinetics Holding Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Board Representative Agreement with Texas Pacific Land Corporation (TPL). Under the agreement, TPL agreed to nominate a Horizon designee, Peter Doyle, to the TPL Board, and he was appointed on May 6, 2026, subject to election at the TPL 2026 annual meeting. Doyle also serves on TPL's strategic acquisitions committee. The agreement includes mutual standstill and non-disparagement clauses, barring negative public statements from both sides until the next TPL stockholders meeting. No stake size, price, or premium was provided. This appears to be the outcome of an activist campaign by Horizon to gain board representation. Watch for ongoing board dynamics and potential strategic M&A moves via the strategic acquisitions committee; the risk-arb angle is limited as no transaction is pending.
